name: Big Features Interview
description: Interview you in depth about a plan or spec using interactive questions, then write the refined spec back to the file. Use to flesh out large features.
description_zh: 围绕计划或规格文档深入提问，并把完善后的规格写回文件，适合大型功能。
prompt:
Here is the current plan:

@$ARGUMENTS

Interview me in detail using the `chat_ui` tool about literally anything: technical implementation, UI and UX, concerns, tradeoffs and so on, but make sure the questions are not obvious.

Be very in-depth and keep interviewing me until the plan is complete, then write the spec back to `$ARGUMENTS`.
